decision_conditions: All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

The roof area of the single storey rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

This permission shall have the effect of varying condition numbered 2 on approved application reference PL/1442/25 dated 17/09/2025. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: D01, D02, D03, D04, D05, D06, D07, D08, PLANNING, DESIGN & ACCESS STATEMENT, Location Plan.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission PL/1442/25 dated 17/09/2025.

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the Construction Logistics Plan (Construction Logistics Plan and Statement) as approved under PL/0490/26 dated 22/04/2026 or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s) (Drawing No. D04) as approved under PL/0490/26 dated 22/04/2026 or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the commencement of works (other than works of demolition), a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>Soft landscape works shall include:&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>a.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>a scheme of hard and soft landscape works which shall include a survey of all existing trees and hedgerows on the land, indicating those to be retained and those to be lost.</p><p>b.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Landscape master plan,&nbsp;</p><p>c.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100),&nbsp;</p><p>d.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities.</p><p>e.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken</p><p>f.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A landscape implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the works.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Hard landscape works shall include:</p><p>g.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Details of boundary treatments (materials, scale of boundary, location),</p><p>h.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Details of hard surfacing materials to be used in the landscaping of the site,&nbsp;</p><p>i.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the details of bin storage (Drawing no. L1 Landscape layout Cycle Storage Bin Storage only for the bin store details) as approved under PL/0490/26 dated 22/04/2026 and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity with the Fire Safety Statement as approved under PL/0490/26 dated 22/04/2026 or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the details of cycle store (Drawing no. L1 Landscape layout Cycle Storage Bin Storage only for the cycle store details) as approved under PL/0490/26 dated 22/04/2026 and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the details of Vehicle Crossover (Drawing no. L1 Landscape layout Cycle Storage Bin Storage for vehicle crossing details) as approved under PL/0490/26 dated 22/04/2026. The approved vehicle crossovers shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be constructed to the specifications of: "Part M, M4 (2), Category 2: Accessible and Adaptable Dwellings" of the Building Regulations 2013 and thereafter retained in that form.</p>

<p>Evidence of certification of Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval in writing before any part of the development is occupied or used. The development shall only be completed and operated in accordance with the approval.</p>

<p>The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the designated refuse storage areas as shown on the approved details set out in Condition 10 of this permission</p>

<p>The construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby permitted shall not be commenced until the following details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Disposal of Surface Water</p><p>b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Disposal of Sewage</p><p>c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Surface Water Attenuation and Storage</p><p>d)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Permeable Paving&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>The construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby permitted (except for demolition works) shall not proceed above the damp proof course level until full details and samples of materials for external surfaces of the ground surfacing have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p><p><br></p><p>The development hereby approved shall also be carried out shall be operated in accordance with the approved full details of materials for the external surfaces of the replacement dwelling and the boundary treatment of the site, including side access gates.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, AA, B, C and D in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p>
description: Variation of condition 2 (Approved Plans) attached to planning permission PL/1442/25 dated 17.9.2025 to allow change of the external walls material from render to bricks
